records.subject: Welcome to Wrenfield, Ridge Group!
records.body:
Hi Mia,

Welcome! Wrenfield works best once there's a real project in it, so that's the one thing I'd suggest doing first. Inviting your team comes next -- tasks are a lot more useful once more than one person is on them.

Reply any time.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

draft.subject: Re: the weekly summary email
draft.body:
Hi Mia,

Quick answer on your question: a weekly summary email isn't available yet, but it's on the roadmap -- so no, you're not missing a setting. Your ticket is still open with support, and they'll follow up there too.

In the meantime, the thing that usually makes Wrenfield click is having one real project in it -- projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them. Want me to walk you through setting up your first project on a short call this week? Happy to work around your schedule.

Best,
Chidi
